rumors.text: The east path is open again, but the crews still won't move after dark.
rumors.notes: Route improvement is true; fear after dark remains local opinion.

rumors.text: The Siphon has started speaking in the old king's voice.
rumors.notes: Explicit rumor, not canon. Contrast with scientific readings.

rumors.text: The Seekers are cataloguing creature changes. Whether every sample is authorized is another question.
rumors.notes: The data effort is plausible; authorization is deliberately uncertain.

rumors.text: The Bastion raised the furnace quota and kept the same brace schedule.
A buyer is paying for route maps from every faction, not just Meridian.
The off-world board has asked for a new evacuation projection. They say it is routine.
rumors.notes: Does not assert that OmniCorp intends to leave.

rumors.text: Some elders want the Siphon destroyed. Others say the Shard never asked for blood.
rumors.notes: Internal dissent; neither interpretation is canon fact.

rumors.text: The Legion is planning permanent water storage beside its new housing blocks.
rumors.notes: Settlement priorities reflect source faction background.

rumors.text: The Custodians are watching Xylos but have not authorized intervention.
rumors.notes: Neutral observation, not a promise of rescue.

rumors.text: The AMA flagged forged CRD samples near the mining grid. A sample is not proof of a coordinated attack.
Old Man Kael calls it the Great Fracture. The archive index uses a different title.
A dock ledger mentions a Meridian Compact. Nobody agrees whether that was an office, a deal, or bad shorthand.
rumors.notes: Do not establish a predecessor without author decision.

rumors.text: They say an operative opened a supply route. I haven't seen the report, but my shelves are filling again.
rumors.notes: Local character observes consequence but cannot confirm identity.

rumors.text: Some records suggest descendants remained on Xylos. The margin note is later than the document it annotates.
rumors.notes: Supplied lore says hidden descendants exist; the archive provenance detail is rumor-level.
